name: monitor-pr
description: Opens a pull request that changes monitor definitions kept in Git: a threshold, a duration, a filter, an exclusion, or the deletion of a monitor. Read the current files first, then give the whole new content of each file you change. Allowed repositories: acme/monitors. Base branch: main. At most 3 files and 40 added and removed lines in all. Allowed paths and their formats: prometheus/rules/** (prometheus_rules), datadog/** (terraform), grafana/alerting/** (grafana_alert_file). Every file is checked with the validator for its format; if it finds errors you get them back and no pull request is opened.
